summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (PrS 74/34)

data.turoyo: Awbele tre kalbe d məskile, d nəḥrinale ǧəlṭina u galdayḏe.
data.translation: bringe ihm zwei Hunde, dass sie ihn packen und erwürgen; wir ziehen ihm dann die Haut ab,

rationale: First Infectum example: unprefixed first-person plural prospective form. Do not import the next verse from the reader's longer context.

summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 84/44)

data.turoyo: Ǧlaṭu taʕlo w zabenu u galdayḏe, gdowe huwe w u ḥmoro xə ḥḏoḏe
data.translation: Zieht dem Fuchs das Fell ab und verkauft es, so dass er und der Esel einander gleich werden

rationale: First Imperativ example; plural command with whole fox as patient, then its skin as sale object.

data.translation: Die Jäger aber zogen ihnen das Fell ab und nahmen es mit.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; plural hides and overt human agents in the edition, followed by taking the skins away.

data.turoyo: Ǧləṭle u galdo d qḏole, maʕlele ʕəl mə qarʕe, səmle saquǧərm
data.translation: Da liess er ihm die Haut vom Nacken ab und über den Kopf ziehen, so dass er ein Scalpirter wurde

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; singular agent and a human neck/skin patient extend the attested animal-hide objects without changing stem I.

data.turoyo: məblili, nḥərili, ǧləṭli ag galdaṯṯe, mḥalaqli bam maye
data.translation: ich habe sie geholt und sie geschlachtet, dann ihnen die Haut abgezogen und dieselbe in's Wasser gelegt

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; first-person singular agent in a complete skin-removal and soaking sequence.

data.turoyo: Ǧləṭṭe u taʕlo, mzabanne u galdayḏe w msəkke u qaṭuno.
data.translation: Da zogen sie dem Fuchs das Fell ab und verkauften es, den Kater nahmen sie fest.

rationale: Fill Preterit to five; explicit whole-animal patient contrasts with the older hide-patient example.

The original abziehen is made explicit for the attested hide-removal use; PrS 84/44–45 also makes the whole fox the patient. This clarifies meaning/object range without splitting one skinning event into two senses.

summary: All eleven occurrences are stem I hide/skin removal. No distinct lexical sense, Detransitive or idiom is established.
The Preterit L-agent forms distinguish ǧləṭle, ǧləṭli and assimilated ǧləṭṭe. ǧəlṭina is Infectum; ǧlaṭu is Imperativ. German liess at PrS 63/8 is contextual causation, not evidence of another stem.
The unchanged plain Preterit at PrS 84/39 presents an already-completed event retrospectively without -wa. The clearer full contexts were preferred.
ǧlṭ is kept distinct from the reader-mentioned glṭ paper/paint use; no root is merged solely on approximate spelling.
PrS 57/15 duplicates the inherited cow-hide/drum sentence cited as prs 153/2 with additional references. Establish the edition-number concordance before altering references or adding it again.
PrS 63/8: is the minister the direct actor or an instigator? Stem I remains the attested form; the edition's causative wording does not settle agency.
The removable hide and the animal being skinned alternate as direct patients; human skin from the neck also occurs. These are patient choices in the same removal event.
